column1: # Everyday English disease names -> ICPC-3 D component. OUR writing, Apache-2.0.
# ICPC-3's own preferred terms and inclusions are indexed straight from
# res/icpc3/icpc3.tsv, so nothing here repeats them. This file holds what a person
# says and a classification does not print: "high blood pressure", "a-fib",
# "water infection". Same two sentinels as conditions_zh.tsv.

column3: iron deficiency (BD66), B12 or folate (BD67), haemolytic (BD65) and other (BD77) are four codes
peptic (DD69/DD70), corneal (FD05) and skin (SD77) ulcers are different codes
osteoarthrosis (LD78/LD79/LD80) and rheumatoid arthritis (LD74) are different diagnoses
the site picks the code: radius/ulna LD35, tibia/fibula LD36, hand/foot LD37, femur LD38
type 1 (TD71) and type 2 (TD72) are separate codes and the classification has no unspecified one
a value, a food and a diabetes euphemism; not a diagnosis
